pages.text: The STAT Mod adds both Fatigue and Thirst systems to increase survival challenge.$(br2)$(l)Fatigue$() builds up from combat and exertion. High fatigue reduces your damage, speed, and mining speed.$(br2)$(l)Thirst$() depletes over time. Sprinting, jumping, and wearing armor increase thirst rate. Hot biomes also drain thirst faster.

$(l)Fatigue Thresholds:$()$(li)Warning (20%): -5% speed$(li)Light (40%): -10% damage/speed$(li)Moderate (60%): -25% damage, -20% speed$(li)Severe (80%): -40% damage, forced walk$(li)Critical (95%): -70% damage$(li)Exhausted (100%): Damage over time

$(l)Thirst Thresholds:$()$(li)Below 25%: Slowness I$(li)Below 10%: Slowness I + hunger acceleration$(li)Empty (0%): Slowness II + confusion + 0.5 heart/sec damage$(br2)Drink water or potions to restore thirst. Rest to recover fatigue.
